violation_type.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys (26 TAC §747.2305(3))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is not equipped with a sufficient number of toys and equipment to keep the infant entertained.
